text.EN: I didn't know you, {subject}. You deserved better.
text.TL: Hindi kita nakilala, {subject}. Hindi mo dapat naranasan ito.

text.EN: I hope someone remembers your name, {subject}.
text.TL: Sana may makaalala pa sa pangalan mo, {subject}.

text.EN: This place takes everyone, doesn't it?
text.TL: Nilalamon ng lugar na ito ang lahat, ano?

text.EN: Someone should have found you sooner, {subject}.
text.TL: Sana may nakakita sa'yo nang mas maaga, {subject}.

text.EN: Rest now, {subject}. I won't leave you unnamed.
text.TL: Magpahinga ka, {subject}. Hindi kita hahayaang mabaon nang walang pangalan.
